messages:
sam-finance: Seeing a weird line on Azure invoice AZ-2024-11-28: 'Reseller Fee (Distributor Pass-Through)' +$3,600. We didn't expect a positive charge. Nina?
nina-partner-ops: That sounds like Azure netted a distributor recovery back to vendors. Do you have the settlement id?
sam-finance: AZ-SET-7782 is on the PDF: https://redwood.example.com/billing/AZ-SET-7782.pdf
azure-marketplace-bot: Settlement AZ-SET-7782 posted 2024-11-28T09:40Z. Amount: 3600.00 USD. Link: https://portal.azure.com/marketplace/settlements/AZ-SET-7782 (requires login).
rachel-ap: AP will hold payment until we confirm routing. Marking ledger entry with note 'pending partner substantiation'.
nina-partner-ops: I see az-ord-993 attached to that settlement; it was routed via Distributor D-7 (CloudBridge) and sub-resold by CP-54 (Lakeview). I'll ping both.
james-sales: Lakeview messaged our AE - they say Azure recovered a previously-paid commission from the distributor and charged vendors. They want confirmation before notifying customers.
sam-finance: For GL treatment: prefer to book as contra-revenue if Azure reduced our net, but if this is a charge we owe to the distributor, book as partner payable. Rachel, leave as payable hold until we get partner docs.
nina-partner-ops: CloudBridge uploaded a reconciliation PDF in the partner portal claiming overpaid commission; Lakeview disputed. I requested signed reconciliation and an Azure PM mapping.
rachel-ap: Got it. AP will not pay and will hold for docs.
sam-finance: Action items: (1) Nina to collect signed reconciliation + Azure mapping; (2) Rachel to keep AP hold; (3) Sam to prepare provisional JE once documents confirm flow. Will update thread. :thumbsup:
